not_covered: New initial orientations, weakened actuators, terrain or impacts
Robot self-collision response or continuous-time path clearance
qualification_economy: Reuse the existing owner, readers, route coverage and factored population. Eight successor controls add retained scalar failures, near-cancellation, rank/cone boundaries, independent optima, exact v1 arithmetic, v2 guarded dispatch, unchanged population/gate and failed-input retention. All 304 predecessor controls remain, for 312 total; no new runner or campaign audit.
purpose: Compare the same eight torque-map recipes across 24 exposed bodies using stable force-cone numerics.
selection_rationale: Eight recipes cross two pose scores, two normal-load rules and primary-versus-all eligible contacts. Each body omits one complementary pair and receives six recipes, three at each factor level. Each recipe covers eighteen bodies, nine in each exposed geometric stratum. Every body also receives a fresh selected reference, its exposed best sharing comparator and two original baselines. Sharing choices are exposed design inputs selected by prior reference gain, not held-out selection. Scores and normalization retain the selected reference's axis, friction and budgets. This is finite factored screening.
braking_model_limit: Constant-velocity lookahead and a stopping-speed envelope using a declared 6 rad/s^2 shaping estimate. This is not a validated physical deceleration bound or a guarantee that no joint crosses its limit.
body_moment_limit: Clear geometric targets are not collision-free transitions. Geometric capsule low points are not measured contact locations. Friction cones and normal load are configured proposals; static joint compensation omits inertial, Coriolis, passive and limit forces. Actual force, contact and sampled work are retained. Motors, native collision filtering and eligibility remain unchanged.
code_path_risks_covered: Batched rank-zero, rank-one and rank-two torque maps with an explicit empty cone
Analytic cone optimum checked against an independent plane-cone construction and rigid frame changes
Pose score and normalization variants change selected poses and guarded commands
Primary versus all eligible contacts changes guarded commands; other observed feet receive bounded zero-torque requests
Unchanged speed, slew and joint protection with reachable active force requests
Pure preparation, atomic batch refusal, upright reset and singular-posture refusal
Two exposed route bodies cover roll- and pitch-axis references, all eight recipes, full replay and compact projection
Retained path screening and fresh varied-start full-capture confirmation remain required before promotion
route_horizon_rationale: Three seconds across two exposed bodies cover repeated pose updates and measured force/contact decisions for all eight recipes using both roll- and pitch-axis references. Twenty-four worlds are split into two batches of twelve. Each new cell must select a clear torque-map pose and emit a bounded force. Quiet contacts, multi-contact commands and no-force fallback must occur somewhere in the route. Mathematical rank degeneracy, upright behavior and rollback have synthetic controls. Missing native coverage consumes the route and blocks compact discovery.
torque_map_limit: A row-space ground force is a model choice. Static balance omits inertia, Coriolis, passive and joint-limit reactions. All observed canonical foot contacts are accounted for by a force or bounded zero-torque request; torso and upper-link reactions remain unmodeled. Zero torque can be unreachable during slew or joint protection, so the residual remains recorded. Geometric targets certify endpoint clearance only. No continuous path, dynamic feasibility, recovery, learned adaptation or release authority.
numerical_successor: Only the versioned tangent construction changes. Preserve rank, friction, normal-load and moment bounds, speed/slew and joint guards, assignments, starts, horizons and five-degree progress. A failure retains exact prepared canonical/native observations before any partial batch application. V1 arithmetic and declarations stay reproducible.
